Container.Name: ambientlightcontrol
Container.Overview: Automation server for a Govee TV backlight: a fixed colour during the day, Video mode while an LG webOS TV is on, off at night. Controlled from the AmbientLight macOS menu bar app. Unofficial, not affiliated with Govee or LG.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: Port the macOS app connects to. Keep it inside your LAN, do not forward it to the internet.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, TV pairing and the API token (file api-token). Must be owned by 99:100.

Config.Name: Govee API key
Config.Description: From the Govee Home app: Profile › Settings › Apply for API Key.

Config.Name: TV address
Config.Description: IP address of the LG TV (give it a fixed address in your router). Can also be set in the app.

Config.Name: Govee device
Config.Description: Only needed if your Govee account has several devices: device name or ID.
